    The tree of sectional paths #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). "Fix a vertex x₀ in the component. Let Δ have as vertices all sectional paths starting at x₀, including the empty path. Join a path to each of its sectional one-arrow extensions, orienting the edge towards the extension. This is a finite rooted tree."

    Throughout, Q is a stable translation quiver on a finite set with at most one arrow between two vertices. This file builds the type SecPath of sectional paths from x₀, shows it is finite when sectional paths are bounded, and equips it with the oriented tree structure (edges from a path to its sectional one-arrow extensions).
